description: This file contains server-side logic for the 'TheorySet' web page of an online examination system. It manages course selection, question addition, and exam setup, including interactions with a SQL database.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'TheorySet' ASP.NET Web Forms page handling course and question management in an online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page. Currently with commented code for session handling, performing no significant action.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on selected semester, adding courses relevant to the user's selection.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the database, updates question number, and notifies the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new exam record for the selected course, and redirects to the AdminPanel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course list based on the selected semester, similar to the 'selectB_Click' method.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Calculates and updates the question number based on the currently selected course.
